services.name: Sailing Into Unknown
services.desc: I kept brewing when we moved aboard our sailboat in Key West. In 2018, Lindsay and I sailed our catamaran across the Atlantic to the UK, over to Europe, down to Africa, and back again. While at sea, I couldn’t brew and experienced firsthand how hard it was to find great-tasting beer for people sensitive to gluten.
